subtasks.task: User can start a focus timer, see countdown, and pause/reset it.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Start starts countdown from work duration (default 1500s).
Timer display (`#timer-display`) updates every second showing MM:SS.
Clicking Pause pauses countdown; timer stops updating.
Clicking Start again after pause resumes from remaining time.
Clicking Reset stops timer and resets display to initial duration.
The Timer module exposes correct state via `getState()` ('idle', 'running', 'paused') after each action.

subtasks.task: User hears an alert sound when the timer finishes.
acceptance_criteria: Calling `Pomodoro.Audio.init()` preloads `sounds/end.mp3` and `sounds/click.mp3` (files must exist).
`Pomodoro.Audio.playSound('timerEnd')` plays the audio immediately (no errors in console).
`Pomodoro.Audio.playSound('click')` plays a click sound.
No JavaScript errors during init or play.

subtasks.task: User can switch between work, short break, and long break modes.
acceptance_criteria: Mode selector dropdown (`#mode-selector`) contains options Work, Short Break, Long Break.
Selecting a mode calls `onModeChange` callback with the correct `SessionMode`.
`getSettings()` returns durations: work=1500, shortBreak=300, longBreak=900.
`setMode()` programmatically changes the active mode and updates the dropdown selection.
UI reflects current mode after page load (default Work).

subtasks.task: User sees an animated circular progress ring and a dynamically generated background image.
acceptance_criteria: SVG circle progress ring (`#circle-progress-fill`) visually fills proportionally when `Animation.updateProgress(fraction)` is called (0 to 1).
`Animation.pulse()` triggers a visual pulse animation on the circle.
`Background.setBackgroundImage()` fetches an image from the banana2 endpoint and sets it as CSS background of `#app-background`, with no CORS errors.
CSS (`css/styles.css`) provides iOS-like typography, button styles, and layout.

subtasks.task: Integrate all modules into a fully working pomodoro app. Wire timer, audio, settings, animations, and background together so user can run complete pomodoro cycles.
acceptance_criteria: On page load, all modules are initialized in correct order (Settings, Timer, Audio, Animation, Background).
Clicking Start creates a Timer with current mode's duration, starts countdown, updates display and animation on tick.
When timer completes, audio plays and the session mode automatically advances (work → short break or long break based on cycle count).
Changing mode via dropdown resets timer with the new duration.
Background image is set on load.
Every button is functional without console errors; app works end-to-end as a pomodoro timer.
